summary: Complaints centre on the damaged Ganga bridge at Anupshahr town, a 10-hour pilgrim jam, the 10-metre Bulandshahr-Anupshahr highway and seasonal Ganga floods, while appreciation is thin and limited to hourly roadways buses and a started bridge repair.
identity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_constituencies_of_the_Uttar_Pradesh_Legislative_Assembly (row 67: Anupshahr, district Bulandshahr, reservation None); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anupshahr_Assembly_constituency (number 67, district Bulandshahr, reservation None; tehsils Anupshahr and Bulandshahr; kanungo circles Anupshahr, Jahangirabad and Aurangabad)

positives.english: Roadways buses run from Bulandshahr to Anupshahr every hour
positives.hindi: बुलंदशहर से अनूपशहर के लिए हर घंटे रोडवेज बस मिलती है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (22 Oct 2025, Ghaziabad Bureau, dateline Bulandshahr): article says buses to Anupshahar currently run every hour, about 6:30 AM to 6:30 PM, from the Bulandshahr roadways stand. Article also says extra buses start 25 Oct before Chhath and every 30 minutes once Kartik Mela begins (plans as stated). No residents quoted. Status after Oct 2025 not verified

positives.english: Repair work on the Anupshahr Ganga bridge is starting
positives.hindi: अनूपशहर गंगा पुल की मरम्मत का काम शुरू होने जा रहा है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (7 Apr 2026, Ghaziabad Bureau, dateline Bulandshahr/Anupshahar): PWD repair and strengthening of the Ganga bridge; work to begin Wednesday 8 Apr 2026 at 7 AM; traffic on the route diverted for about 15 days. Headline says 'from today', body gives 8 Apr. No completion date stated; no residents quoted; completion not found in any source checked

positives.english: *Rs 493 crore came into the accounts of farmers hit by floods
positives.hindi: *बाढ़ से नुकसान वाले किसानों के खाते में 493 करोड़ रुपये आए
positives.basis: Inference: All India Radio (12 Oct 2026): Rs 493 crore to 9,18,091 farmers for losses from floods, heavy rain, hailstorm and cyclone; event organised in Gorakhpur. Neither Anupshahr nor Bulandshahr is named, so local receipt is not confirmed. Statewide; weak positive pending field check

positives.english: *Roadways buses are planned from Shikarpur to Anupshahr and Pahasu
positives.hindi: *शिकारपुर से अनूपशहर के लिए रोडवेज बसें चलने की योजना है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (11 Dec 2025, Ghaziabad): Bulandshahr depot plans two buses each on Shikarpur-Anupshahr and Shikarpur-Pahasu routes. Article says buses are not running yet and villages are being surveyed first; no start date. A plan, not a delivered benefit, so it is weak under the positives rule

positives.english: *I hear a four-lane proposal for the Bulandshahr-Anupshahr road has been sent to the state
positives.hindi: *सुना है बुलंदशहर-अनूपशहर सड़क को चार लेन करने का प्रस्ताव भेजा गया है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026, Ghaziabad): PWD has sent a Rs 175 crore four-lane proposal to the state; approval expected within about two months. An announcement only, not a delivered benefit; listed because no other planned benefit for Anupshahr was found in sources checked

negatives.english: The Ganga bridge at Anupshahr has deep potholes and iron rods showing
negatives.hindi: अनूपशहर का गंगा पुल खस्ताहाल है, सरिया तक बाहर दिख रहा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (21 Oct 2025, Ghaziabad Bureau): deep potholes in several places, iron rods exposed, drivers facing difficulty. PWD Assistant Engineer Satyendra Chaudhary said heavy traffic vibration causes the potholes and patch repairs would be done soon, with full fix after festivals because of labour shortage. Article says potholes were filled several times earlier but repairs did not last

negatives.english: A 10-hour jam in Anupshahr when pilgrims crowded the Ganga for Shraddh Purnima bath
negatives.hindi: श्राद्ध पूर्णिमा पर गंगा स्नान की भीड़ में अनूपशहर में 10 घंटे जाम
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026, Ghaziabad Bureau): jam lasted about 10 hours, Friday night to Saturday afternoon, during Shradh Purnima Ganga bath crowds. Queues from Mastram Ghat to Roopwas and about 2 km to Karanpur village on the Anupshahar-Bulandshahr road; the Anupshahar Adda to Bulandshahr Adda bypass was full. SP Dehat and CO Anupshahr came onto the roads with police; CO blamed sudden vehicle pressure and drivers going the wrong way. No future measures announced; no residents quoted. Mastram Ghat, Roopwas and Karanpur are not named in the Wikipedia extent; they are within Anupshahr town and its approaches, so membership is unconfirmed beyond the town itself

negatives.english: Ganga flood covered Anupshahr ghats and the road to Gangadwar, and farm crops went under water
negatives.hindi: गंगा उफान पर, घाट डूबे, गंगा द्वार की सड़क तक पानी पहुंचा
negatives.basis: Patrika (published 31 Jul 2026, datelined Anupshahr, Bulandshahr): Ganga rose quickly at Anupshahr; several main ghats submerged; flood water reached the main road to Gangadwar; flood water covered forest and farm land in Ahar, Mubarakpur, Margpur, Sirora, Torai and Bachchi Khera; maize, jowar, bajra and sugarcane standing in fields began to go under water. Ahar and Serora (Sirora) appear in the Wikipedia extent of AC 67; Gangadwar and the ghats are within Anupshahr town. The source URL sits under a bijnor-news path but its content concerns Anupshahr

negatives.english: The Bulandshahr-Anupshahr highway is only 10 metres wide with about 1.5 lakh vehicles a day
negatives.hindi: बुलंदशहर-अनूपशहर सड़क सिर्फ 10 मीटर चौड़ी है, रोज डेढ़ लाख गाड़ियां चलती हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026, Bulandshahr edition): the state highway is 10 m wide now; it was widened from 7 m about eight years ago; about 1.5 lakh vehicles use it daily. PWD has sent a Rs 175 crore four-laning proposal. The road runs between Bulandshahr and Anupshahr; AC membership of the Bulandshahr end is not confirmed, so this is partly district-level

negatives.english: Morning traffic jams make it hard for vegetable farmers to reach the Anupshahr and Bulandshahr mandis
negatives.hindi: सुबह के जाम में सब्जी किसानों को मंडी जाने में परेशानी
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026, Bulandshahr edition): thousands of farmers from villages near the highway bring vegetables daily to the Bulandshahr and Anupshahr mandis; heavy morning traffic causes them significant trouble. No farmer quoted; the claim is the article's own. District-level along the highway

notes: Search coverage: about 15 searches in Hindi and English, including Roman-spelling Amar Ujala terms, water, power, sugarcane, health, schools, drains, Ganga ghats and bridge repair status. No Anupshahr-specific 2024-2026 reporting on water, power, sugarcane dues, CHC, schools or jobs was found, so those topics are absent rather than shown to be fine. Narora appeared in Ganga flood results but is not in the AC 67 extent and was not used. Jahangirabad-side ghat search returned nothing. Bridge repair completion and whether the 15-day closure ended not found. Whether hourly buses still run after Oct 2025 not verified. Wikipedia AC page is the source for extent; it lists Serora (not Sirora) and Ahar. Population figures on Wikipedia are 2001 census. Field check needed on: bridge status, bus frequency, Shikarpur buses, Ganga flood damage in Ahar and Serora villages. Round 3 voice pass. P2 weak positive: the start is announced for 8 Apr 2026, with no progress or completion report found. P4 weak positive: a bus plan with no start date. P5 weak positive: a proposal awaiting approval, not a delivered benefit. P3 is statewide; Anupshahr is not named in the source.

round2.changes: Opened all 8 unique item URLs and checked claims. Removed unsupported details from bases: Pos1 and Pos5 extra claims, Neg2 'parking' and 5 km claim, Neg3 Bijnor barrage/2.5 ft/fodder/'under control' claims and Jahnavi platform, Neg4 'busiest highway' and overtaking/Shravan claims and unverified 'outside AC' claim, Neg5 corrected from 'cannot reach' to 'trouble reaching'. Neg2 and Neg3 kept as AC-specific (Anupshahr town, Ahar and Serora). Lowered ac_specific_negatives from 4 to 3 (Neg4 and Neg5 are district-level). Neg2 Hindi unchanged. Pos3 now flagged as statewide. Pos4 and Pos5 kept as flagged inference because no delivered Anupshahr benefit was found to replace them. Re-ranked: negatives unchanged in order. Hindi trimmed to 13 words or fewer where needed
